key_insights: Market waiting for confirmation before positioning - either strength (invalidation of breakdown) or value (cheaper prices)
BTC value area 14,000-20,000 from cycle-to-cycle perspective
Best altcoin plays typically happen long after BTC and ETH have bottomed
200-week moving averages are key support levels for both BTC (~20k) and ETH (~1k)
Monthly timeframe remains bearish - weekly and daily need to show strength first
Trading philosophy: wait for crypto to invalidate itself - either through strength (reclaiming levels) or reaching value areas
summary: Market is in a clear downtrend with BTC and ETH below key support levels. Cred recommends waiting for either strength signals (reclaiming broken levels) or for prices to reach value areas (14k-20k for BTC, 1k for ETH) before accumulating. Altcoin season is not here yet - focus on BTC and ETH first.
